summary.text: Javier Martínez is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 11 who took office on January 1, 2015, and has served as speaker of the House since 2023; he is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
An attorney by profession, Martínez has worked as a policy director and general counsel at the Partnership for Community Action, a community organizer and a public health advocate.

paragraphs.text: Martínez graduated from high school in Albuquerque and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Mexico and a J.D. in international and comparative law from the UNM School of Law in 2010.

His professional experience includes working as a policy director and general counsel at the Partnership for Community Action, as a community organizer, and as a public health advocate for the University of Michigan.
Martínez first won election to the New Mexico House in 2014, and he served as state House majority floor leader from 2021 to 2023.
On January 18, 2023, Martínez was elected speaker of the House for the 2023-2024 session, and he won re-election to the position at the start of the 2025 session.
In the 2025-2026 session, Martínez serves on the Rules and Order of Business Committee, the Taxation & Revenue Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
Speaking about his motivation to seek public office, Martínez said a critical issue was New Mexico's lack of access to quality early childhood education services for children.
